axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y). Front = Roblox -Z. Held items: Grip at the origin, look = item axis (Roblox +Y), up = edge / front (Roblox -Z), as ItemsReal.
textures: none: one flat colour per part, no vertex colours. The importer drops colours, so set Material and Color from this manifest.

stars.rule: Same mesh at every star; only Role colours/materials change. ItemModels.build(id, stars) sets each part from parts[].stars[stars-1]. Etch parts are the blade/limb colour below 5 stars and show as a darker steel band or brass inlay at 5.

import: Every held item and far model: CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch off, CollisionFidelity Box, Massless; viewmodel copies CastShadow off.
Far models (<id>_Far) share the near model's Grip and attachments; swap at about 40 studs or use them for other players' third-person weapons.
Bows: hide <bow>_Rope while drawing and draw Beams between StringTop, the Nock and StringBottom.
KitParcel colliding parts: Canvas only (Box). KitChute and KitChuteFolded are visual only.
Strongbox: Lid and LidMetal parts rotate about LidHinge (+X).
PrizeWheel: place the Stand, put the Disc's origin on Stand.Axle and spin it about the axle (Roblox Z). OddsPlaque takes a SurfaceGui (Face Front) with the odds.
Nothing is Neon. Metal parts stay matte (Metal material, no reflectance).

assets.name: knife
assets.notes: Hunting Knife. Clip-point blade with a honed bevel strip, oval guard, leather handle, iron pommel. Grip at the origin, blade +Y (Roblox), edge Roblox -Z.

assets.name: machete
assets.notes: Machete. Long single-edged blade widening to a clipped tip, slab leather-wrapped handle with three rivets, iron bolster and butt.

assets.name: hatchet
assets.notes: Hatchet. Eight-sided haft with a flared butt, leather grip band, wedge head with a flared bit and a honed edge, short poll, iron collar.

assets.name: spear
assets.notes: Spear. Pale stave shaft (the trailer's training staves), leather grip, cord binding, iron socket and butt cap, leaf-shaped double-edged head.

assets.name: sword
assets.notes: Longsword, new look (from the training-hall blades): long narrow straight single-edged blade with a raised back spine, small square crossguard, grip of stacked rings, flat disc pommel.

assets.name: twin_axe
assets.notes: Twin-Bit Axe (new; from the thrown double-bit axe in the trailer, our own design): long straight pale ash haft, dark leather band at the grip, steel collar, broad symmetrical head of two mirrored flared bits with honed 3-facet arcs. Spins end over end when thrown.

assets.name: ring_blade
assets.notes: Ring Blade (new; a flat steel hoop, our own design): 16-segment hoop 2.2 across with a honed outer bevel over the front two thirds, a leather-wrapped back arc as a knuckle guard, a steel grip bar across the inside wrapped in cord with brass ferrules. Held at the bar; flies flat.

throw.spinAxis: Roblox +X through Spin (flat spin, hoop stays level)

assets.name: climb_pick
assets.notes: Climbing Pick (new; the alpine valley): six-sided hickory haft, leather grip, rawhide wrist loop, iron foot spike, socket head with a curved 4-segment pick and a square adze.

assets.name: bow
assets.notes: Recurve Bow (3 to 4 a round; never owned). Wooden riser with an arrow window on the -X side, leather grip, tapered limbs that recurve at the tips, horn tip overlays, linen string. v1 attachments kept exactly (Nock, StringTop, StringBottom, ArrowRest). Hide bow_Rope while drawing.

assets.name: short_bow
assets.notes: Short Bow (new; the Archer kit's bow): plain flat-limbed self bow, limbs two tapered slabs, tan leather grip block, no recurve. Same attachment names as the bow; hide short_bow_Rope while drawing.

assets.name: throwing_knife
assets.notes: Throwing Knife (stack 6, no stars): one-piece double-edged spear point, cord-wrapped tang, ring pommel. Uses the 1-star colours.

assets.name: arrow
assets.notes: Arrow (ammunition, no stars): pale shaft, iron nock, leaf head, three vanes (one cock vane in ember). Origin = Nock (v1 convention); +Y along the string side.

assets.name: wire_snare
assets.notes: Wire Snare (Trapper kit, stack 2, no stars): a sharpened stake with a coil of wire and a running noose, cord tie. Grip = middle of the stake. Glint is game-side, not in the mesh.

assets.name: StarIcon
assets.notes: Small matte star (1 stud across) for hotbar/plaque/wheel marks. Faces Roblox -Z (front), top point Roblox +Y. Pivot = centre of the back face. Recolour from Theme (4-5 stars: matte Theme.Colors.Gold). Never Neon.

assets.name: KitParcel
assets.notes: The kit parcel (midpoint sponsor drop): pale grey canvas block with a white tube strapped to the front, cord tied in a cross, a small ember card tag. Pivot = floor centre. Opens like a crate: Prompt in front, items spill at LootPoint. ChuteRig on top takes KitChute's origin.

assets.name: KitChute
assets.notes: Open chute for the parcel's 7 s fall: an 8-panel canopy in alternating ember and charcoal canvas (never silver), 7.2 across, 8 lines to a small iron rig ring. Origin = the rig ring: put it on KitParcel.ChuteRig. Panels are thin closed shells, so the canopy reads from below too. Visual only (no collision).

assets.name: KitChuteFolded
assets.notes: The chute after landing, folded over on the ground beside the parcel. Pivot = floor centre. Visual only.

assets.name: Strongbox
assets.notes: Strongbox: plain dark steel case with iron bands, corner caps and three latches. Sits on the prize counter in the train. Pivot = floor centre. Body + Lid (+ LidMetal, tagged Lid) rotate about LidHinge (+X axis) about 100 degrees to open; three latch clicks first.

assets.name: MasterworkStrongbox
assets.notes: Masterwork Strongbox: blued steel with brass bands, corners and latches. Sits on the prize counter in the train. Pivot = floor centre. Body + Lid (+ LidMetal, tagged Lid) rotate about LidHinge (+X axis) about 100 degrees to open; three latch clicks first.

assets.name: PrizeWheel_Stand
assets.notes: The prize wheel's stand for the train: a dark-wood plinth with a brass odds plaque on its front (OddsPlaque: SurfaceGui with the odds), an iron post and braces, the axle housing and a bracket over the top that holds the leather pointer tongue. 4.6 wide, 1.9 deep, 8.4 tall: fits a 6.5 stud wall panel beside a car's end door, under the 10.5 ceiling. Pivot = floor centre, front Roblox -Z. Put PrizeWheel_Disc's origin on Axle.

assets.name: PrizeWheel_Disc
assets.notes: The spinning disc, 5.6 across: dark wood backing, 10 matte enamel segments drawn at their true odds (Weapons_v2 5.2), a brass rim with a brass peg at every segment boundary for the tongue to click over, a brass hub. Marks are our own: Gold segments carry 1/2/3 small ingots (40/80/200), weapon segments 3/4/1 small stars (3/4/5 stars). No lights, no casino imagery. Origin = axle centre; spin about Roblox Z (the axle). 'segments' lists each segment's angles, measured from the pointer (Roblox +Y) toward Roblox +X; to land on a segment, turn the disc so its centreDeg sits under the pointer.
